name: Tourist visa (TR) / visa exemption

requirement_groups.name: Eligible-nationality visa exemption or TR visa

requirements.blocker_text: Many nationalities enter visa-free for stays up to 60 days (extendable once for 30 more at an immigration office); other nationalities need a consular Tourist Visa (TR), typically valid 60 days and extendable once for 30.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a TR visa at a Thai embassy or consulate if not visa-exempt.

requirements.blocker_text: Covers tourism and short social/business visits; does not authorise any form of paid work, including remote work for a foreign employer.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the DTV or another relevant route instead if any income-generating work is intended.

evidence_required.document: Proof of onward travel and sufficient funds

outcome.duration_length: up to 60 days, extendable once for 30 more days (visa exemption); TR visa follows a similar structure

sources.title: ThaiEmbassy.com -- visa category overview describing visa exemption and Tourist Visa (TR) structure

In-country conversion from tourist status to a long-term category is not permitted for most routes; applicants typically need to leave Thailand and apply for the target visa from a Thai embassy or consulate abroad, though the DTV and some other categories can be processed while the applicant is inside Thailand on a different valid status.
